senses.definition: horse, steed (less common synon. of סוּס (> explained away by SchwallyZAW viii (1888), 191); Arabic فَرَسٌ horse, mare (often), so Ethiopic ፈረስ, cf. Sab. פרס horse, MordtmHim. Inschr. 70);—pl. פָּרָשִׁים (erron. for פְּרָשִׁים Köii, 1, 89) Ez 27:14 +, sf. פָּרָשָׁיו Is 28:28 1 S 8:11;—steeds Ez 27:14 (+ סוּסִים, פְּרָדִים), from Togarmah; sim. of swiftness Jo 2:4 (‖ סוּסִים); prob. also Is 28:28 Je 46:4 (‖ סוּסִים, cf. Gf Gie), and perhaps וְשָׂם לוֹ בְּמֶרְכַבְתּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו וְרָצוּ וגו׳ 1 S 8:11 (kg. subj.).
